---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem statement

What problem are you trying to solve? Why does it matter? (e.g. "Screener results don't surface sector-relative momentum, so it's hard to compare growth stocks across sectors.")

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you'd like. Be specific about scope, API surface, UI placement, expected behavior.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one preferred?

## Scope / non-goals

What is explicitly out of scope for this request?

## Additional context

Links to academic references, screenshots, mock-ups, related issues, prior art in other tools.
